text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Israeli newspapers on Friday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
JERUSALEM POST
- Israeli Foreign Minister David Levy to Palestinian leader Yasser Arafat: Uproot Palestinian Authority police terrorism.
- Israeli army arrests Hamas cell, puts out kidnap alert.
- Palestinian Authority security failures hamper U.S. efforts.
- Parties trade blame for bridge collapse.
- Seven Arad Festival figures to be indicted.
- Treasury adds 200 million shekels to proposed budget cuts, raising total to 800 million shekels. Government debate next week.
- Local centre gets 10 percent of Hewlett-Packard Company research budget.
- European Union lifts Israel poultry ban.
GLOBES
- Controlling owner of Paz group Jack Lieberman dies.
- Mazda importers suspected of 100 million shekel customs evasion.
HAARETZ
- Arafat to Israel's Shin Bet chief Ami Ayalon: I'll investigate the activities of the Palestinian police.
- Police investigate Israeli income tax commissioner under warning.
- Agreement between Antiquities Authority and ultra-Orthodox: Any digging in old cemeteries in government projects will be conditioned on Religious Affairs ministry approval.
- Fire damage at Israel Aircraft Industries plant $80-100 million, far more than initially estimated.
- Despite sharp drop in grant, Tower Semiconductors decides to establish a plant in Migdal Haemek in Israel.
MAARIV
- Shin Bet warns: Arafat losing control over his people.
- Israel's West Bank commander Gabi Ofir: If the Palestinians bring us to battles, we'll respond harshly and painfully.
- Labour party leader Ehud Barak jeered speaking of a compromise on the Golan.
YEDIOTH AHRONOTH

- Israel's Shin Bet chief tells Arafat: Without a review of the internal situation, your life will be in danger. Palestinian police commander gave orders to carry out attacks, says senior Israeli security official. Arafat's aide says it isn't so.
- Israel's West Bank commander Gabi Ofir: The settlers give us the feeling we're their punching bag.
YERUSHALAYIM
- Fatah leaflet calls for attacks on Israeli targets in Arab East Jerusalem.
KOL HA'IR
- Netanyahu family gets permit to hire a Filipina nanny contrary to regulations.
